idea-plugin.name: ij-format MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Format selected lines of Java or Kotlin from an MCP client using IntelliJ IDEA's native formatter.

  • Use the current IDE-wide code style, including while a project is open.
  • Send a standalone source snippet and line range to the local ij_format_lines tool.
  • Manage the loopback server and copy its connection JSON from Settings > Tools > ij-format MCP.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Scoped Java and Kotlin formatting through local MCP, with automatic startup at the Welcome screen and an IDE settings page.
